usage: tr usage [-h] [--by {arm,call,day,run}] [--run RUN_ID] [--since DATE]

cost per run, arm, day or call from the saved run files, then the OpenRouter
key's lifetime spend and the two reconciled (free reads)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --by {arm,call,day,run}
                        group the calls by (default run)
  --run RUN_ID          only this run's calls
  --since DATE          only calls on or after this New York date (YYYY-MM-DD)
